channel.title: Quiet Money
channel.description: The money rules nobody taught you.

item.title: Write Your Asset Column in 10 Minutes
item.description: Learn how to build a real asset column in ten minutes. Distinguish between assets and liabilities and set up automated momentum today.

item.title: Why You Rewrite Your Money Memories
item.description: Hindsight bias tricks you into believing your financial intuition is flawless by rewriting your past memories of market moves.

item.title: The $5 Daily Habit That Costs You $226,000
item.description: We break down the exact compounding math of a $5 daily habit invested in an index fund at 8% annually versus spending it on daily takeout drinks.

item.title: The $35 Billion Illusion: How Eike Batista Lost It All
item.description: Eike Batista became the world's 7th richest man with a $35 billion paper net worth built on speculative oil projections and heavy debt. When real oil production failed to materialize, his paper empire collapsed into over $1 billion of debt in under 18 months.

item.title: The 0% Balance Transfer Fee Math
item.description: Calculating the exact break-even point and hidden fees when moving high-interest debt to a 0% introductory rate card.

item.title: How a Billionaire Lost His NFL Team at Blackjack
item.description: The true story of Leonard Tose losing the Philadelphia Eagles at the blackjack table, and the money psychology lesson on sunk costs and discipline.

item.title: The Checking Account Cash Trap
item.description: Keeping six months of living expenses in a standard checking account creates massive inflation drag. Learn the Tiered Liquidity Rule to keep your cash safe and productive.

item.title: Why Buying Cash Flow Beats Starting from Zero
item.description: Starting a business from scratch comes with high failure rates and unpaid years. Acquiring established cash flow using debt leverage offers an alternative path, though managing loan obligations during down years is critical.

item.title: The Cost-Per-Use Rule That Saves Thousands
item.description: Why buying the cheapest option often drains your wealth through high replacement frequency. Use the Cost-Per-Use rule to evaluate true lifetime cost.

item.title: Why Your Next Raise Won't Set You Free
item.description: A higher salary rarely creates freedom because lifestyle creep spends every new dollar. Learn how replacing fear and desire with real assets builds true passive income.

item.title: Why You Waste Tax Refunds (And How to Stop)
item.description: Exposing the House Money Effect and mental accounting bias. Learn why treating tax refunds differently than paychecks leads to wasted cash, and how single-bucket routing fixes it.

item.title: The Brutal Math of Starting at 20 vs 30
item.description: Comparing the math of investing $200 a month starting at age 20 versus waiting until 30, assuming an 8% return until age 65.

item.title: The Silent Inflation Cash Devaluation
item.description: Computing the exact purchasing power loss of keeping cash in a 0.01% savings account over 15 years at a historical 3% inflation rate.

item.title: Stop Getting Blindsided By Bills You Knew Were Coming
item.description: Annual bills like car registration, insurance renewals, and holiday gifts feel like sudden emergencies when paid all at once. This 15-minute sinking fund system splits irregular expenses into payday automated transfers so you never pay debt interest on predictable life expenses.

item.title: Why 'Free' Makes You Spend $50 Extra
item.description: Explaining the Zero-Price Effect and why free shipping prompts consumers to overspend on items they do not need. Includes compounding math showing the long-term cost of daily micro-waste.

item.title: The Graffiti Artist Who Chose Risk Over Cash
item.description: How artist David Choe traded a $60,000 wall-painting gig for Facebook stock worth $200 million, proving the power of asymmetric equity risk.

item.title: Why Staying at One Company Costs You 50% in Income
item.description: Staying at one company longer than two years can cost you up to 50% in lifetime earnings. Learn why corporate budgets cap internal raises at 3% while paying market rates for new hires.

item.title: The Gold Myth That Drains Long-Term Wealth
item.description: Gold is often marketed as the ultimate safe-haven asset, but history shows it lags far behind productive, income-generating assets over long time horizons.

item.title: The Nurse Who Died With $9 Million
item.description: A lifelong nurse quietly amassed millions by refusing to sell her inherited stocks, proving the wealth-destroying cost of unnecessary portfolio tinkering.

item.title: Why Your Budget Fails (And How to Fix It)
item.description: Learn why traditional budgeting fails and how reframing your budget as a permission slip eliminates financial guilt while building real long-term wealth.

item.title: The Paycheck Replacement Equation: Yield vs Portfolio
item.description: Learn how targeting net yield and side cash flow reduces the portfolio needed to replace a monthly salary. Math breakdown using proven financial models.

item.title: Why You Research Expensive Things Before Buying Them
item.description: Confirmation bias leads us to hunt for positive reviews to justify purchases we emotionally made in seconds. Breaking this cycle and investing small amounts compounding over decades turns impulse spending into real wealth.

item.title: The Bi-Weekly Mortgage Hack That Erases 8 Years
item.description: Learn how switching to a bi-weekly mortgage payment schedule creates 13 full monthly payments every year instead of 12. This extra principal-only payment turns a 30-year mortgage into a 22-year loan without changing your overall budget.

item.title: The $5 Coffee Myth Trapping Your Paycheck
item.description: Skipping small daily luxuries won't solve systemic money problems. Learn why obsessing over micro-expenses creates budget fatigue while major expenses like housing and transportation quietly dictate your net worth.

item.title: The Hot-Hand Fallacy: Why One Win Triggers Ruin
item.description: Discover why a single lucky win in business or trading makes people risk their entire net worth on the next gamble, and how the hot-hand fallacy drains accounts.

item.title: Why Your Student Loan Balance Keeps Growing
item.description: Learn the math behind negative amortization in student loan income-driven repayment plans and why low minimum payments cause your total debt to balloon.

item.title: The Artist Who Paid Expensive Meals With Simple Doodles
item.description: Discover how sculptor Alexander Calder used personal skill instead of cash to pay for meals, and the money lesson behind it.

item.title: The Cashflow Quadrant Shift: Moving to Passive Income
item.description: Learn the math and strategy behind the Cashflow Quadrant. Discover how shifting from earned income to passive income assets changes your financial future.

item.title: Cancel Hidden Roku Add-On Channels in 3 Steps
item.description: Overlooked streaming add-ons billed through TV hardware like Roku silently drain your bank balance. Follow this 3-step audit on your web browser to eliminate unused channel subscriptions today.

item.title: The $18 Million Lottery Winner Who Gave It All Away
item.description: Janite Lee won $18 million in 1993 and lost it all to endless giving within a decade. Here is the hidden danger of a zero-perimeter financial life.
